Prune the readboj cache to explicit bounds

Source: R/cache.R
boj_cache_prune.Rd

boj_cache_prune() removes the oldest regular content-addressed raw response objects until both configured bounds are satisfied. It also removes request index files that point to an object removed in the same call. Object age is determined by file modification time, oldest first. This is a maintenance operation on an existing cache only: it does not fetch, validate, or rebuild responses and it never needs network access.

Usage

boj_cache_prune(
  cache_dir = boj_cache_dir(),
  max_bytes = 1024^3,
  max_entries = 1000L
)

Arguments

cache_dir

Path passed to dir.exists() for the readboj cache directory. The default is boj_cache_dir(), which uses the readboj.cache_dir option or tools::R_user_dir("readboj", "cache").

max_bytes

Maximum total bytes of retained raw response objects. The value must be a finite non-negative number; zero removes every eligible object.

max_entries

Maximum number of retained raw response objects. The value must be a finite non-negative whole number; zero removes every eligible object.

Value

A four-column data frame with one row and columns removed (integer count), bytes_removed (numeric byte count), remaining (integer object count), and remaining_bytes (numeric byte count). The values describe eligible regular object files after the attempted pruning. There is no provenance attribute because this function reports a local maintenance action rather than a source response.

Details

Only files in the readboj cache objects/ and requests/ subdirectories that match the package's own names are candidates. Directories, symbolic links, malformed indexes, and unrelated files are left untouched. If cache_dir does not exist, no directory is created and a zero summary is returned. Removed response files and indexes are not moved to a recoverable trash location; callers can obtain them again only by re-fetching the corresponding official source (subject to its availability and terms).

See also

boj_provenance()

Examples

# A missing cache is handled without creating directories or using a network.
summary <- boj_cache_prune(tempfile("readboj-cache-"), max_bytes = 0,
  max_entries = 0L)
stopifnot(identical(summary$removed, 0L), identical(summary$remaining, 0L))
